name: gi-fixture
description: RFC 0011 GI fixtures: a converged, denoised flat lightmap baked with the gi-reference Cycles light paths (64 diffuse bounces, no clamping), with separated direct and indirect LMAP v2 layers, and a PRBV probe volume at 1 m spacing (tools/quality/probe_volume_bake.py), a radiosity transfer, and an SDFV signed distance volume at 0.1 m voxels for the SDF-traced producer. No reflection probe, no directional page and no pipeline reference render: the fixtures' Cycles references come from tools/quality/gi_reference.py and their oracles from tools/quality/gi_runtime.py. Since 2026-09-30 the radiosity transfer (RTRN), the SDF volume (SDFV) and the reflection probes' relight bands are not baked: moving-light GI is out of scope (user decision), so the indirect light is the bake's and those data served only RFC 0011's opt-in producers.
